title: Coordinated TNF-NF-kappaB and PI3K-Akt Modulation by Yueju Pill in Hashimoto's Thyroiditis: A Network Pharmacology and Molecular Docking Study.
authors: Zhang, Hao; Ren, Kuojun; Wang, Shengying
one_liner_zh: 该研究用网络药理学和分子对接分析越鞠丸治疗桥本甲状腺炎的靶点与通路，虽涉及蛋白-小分子对接，但非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: To predict the polypharmacological mechanism of Yueju pill (YJP) against Hashimoto's thyroiditis (HT), this study integrated network pharmacology and molecular docking to develop a computationally derived "dual-axis core" hypothesis involving the TNF-NF-kappaB inflammatory axis and the PI3K-Akt survival/apoptosis axis. Candidate active compounds and putative targets were identified, followed by PPI network construction and GO and KEGG enrichment analyses. Representative compounds were further evaluated by molecular docking, with redocking and reference-ligand comparisons used to assess docking reliability. A total of 167 common drug-disease targets were identified, from which 13 hub targets were screened. Enrichment analysis highlighted the TNF, PI3K-Akt, IL-17, Th17 cell differentiation, and apoptosis-related pathways. Quercetin, luteolin, kaempferol, and wogonin showed predicted interactions with multiple inflammation- and apoptosis-related targets. Redocking reproduced crystallographic binding modes for CASP3, IKBKB, MAPK1, and AKT1 with RMSD values below 2.0 A. Overall, the integrated computational analyses support a testable "dual-axis core" hypothesis in which YJP may coordinately modulate inflammatory and survival/apoptosis-related signaling in HT, providing prioritized targets and a mechanistic framework for future experimental validation.
abstract_zh: 为预测越鞠丸（YJP）对抗桥本甲状腺炎（HT）的多药理学机制，本研究整合网络药理学和分子对接技术，提出了一种计算衍生的“双轴核心”假说，涉及TNF-NF-kappaB炎症轴和PI3K-Akt生存/凋亡轴。鉴定了候选活性化合物和推定靶点，随后进行PPI网络构建以及GO和KEGG富集分析。代表性化合物通过分子对接进一步评估，并使用重新对接和参考配体比较来评估对接可靠性。共鉴定出167个共同的药物-疾病靶点，从中筛选出13个枢纽靶点。富集分析突出了TNF、PI3K-Akt、IL-17、Th17细胞分化和凋亡相关通路。槲皮素、木犀草素、山柰酚和汉黄芩素显示出与多个炎症和凋亡相关靶点的预测相互作用。重新对接重现了CASP3、IKBKB、MAPK1和AKT1的晶体结合模式，RMSD值低于2.0 Å。总体而言，整合计算分析支持一个可测试的“双轴核心”假说，即YJP可能协调调节HT中的炎症和生存/凋亡相关信号，为未来实验验证提供了优先靶点和机制框架。
